passage:
Thursday night.
It started as Binita and Leela being annoyed about who forgot to bring the chart paper. Now it's the whole class. Leela's friends sit on one side of the room, Binita's on the other, and I'm stuck on the middle bench. Today at break, Sunidhi told everyone what Binita had said about Leela's brother on the phone last month, which was supposed to be private. Then Binita's group told everyone that Leela cries in the washroom. Nobody even mentions the chart paper anymore. I don't think Binita or Leela remember it. They look at each other like enemies, and their "teams" keep feeding it. I miss when it was only a small fight.
— Nirmala

qa.q: What did the quarrel first start over?
qa.a: It started over who forgot to bring the chart paper.

qa.q: How does Nirmala feel about the fight now?
qa.a: Nirmala feels stuck in the middle and sad; the line "I miss when it was only a small fight" shows it.

qa.q: What could Nirmala do from the middle bench to stop the camps growing?
qa.a: Nirmala could refuse to pass on private things and suggest that Binita and Leela talk alone about what actually hurt.

qa.q: How is Leela likely affected when private things are spread?
qa.a: Leela is probably embarrassed and betrayed, and the chart-paper hurt is now buried under a much bigger one. 😔

grounding: Shows a classmate watching friends take sides and repeat private words until a small quarrel becomes two camps.

passage:
Eshaan: did you see what Varun said about Dev in the group
Chinmay: yeah
Eshaan: we have to back Dev. Varun's been like this since class 8
Eshaan: I'm posting what Varun told me about Dev's dad at the sleepover
Chinmay: wait what. that was private
Eshaan: so? he started it
Chinmay: this was Varun and Dev arguing about the football team spot
Chinmay: now it's like 10 of us
Chinmay: half the team isn't talking to the other half
Eshaan: you're either with us or with them
Chinmay: I'm with nobody
Chinmay: I just want to know if Dev's even ok
Chinmay: has anyone actually asked him?
Eshaan: ...
Eshaan: no 😶
Eshaan: ok I won't post it
Chinmay: I'll call Dev tonight

qa.q: What were Varun and Dev first arguing about?
qa.a: They were arguing about the football team spot.

qa.q: What does Chinmay worry about while the team splits into sides?
qa.a: Chinmay worries whether Dev is even okay, since nobody has asked him while everyone takes sides.

qa.q: What went right in this chat, and what could Chinmay do next?
qa.a: Chinmay refused to pick a camp and stopped the private story being posted; calling Dev tonight lets the real hurt be heard.

qa.q: What would change if Eshaan posted the sleepover story?
qa.a: A private moment about Dev's dad would become public, the camps would harden, and the original quarrel would be even harder to fix.

grounding: Shows a teen observing friends join sides and threaten to share private words, turning a two-person quarrel into two camps.
